Civil Service: helping you with managing contracts and suppliers

Information on new training and accreditation available for any civil servant who works with contracts or suppliers, even if this is a small part of your role.

Civil Service

Initial guidance and signposting for new in role contract managers (HTML)

HTML

Details

To promote and champion good practice, and the professionalisation of public sector contract management, the Civil Service is investing in training and accreditation - through the Contract Management Capability Programme.

This structured programme of training will help and enable you to manage contracts and third party suppliers providing services to central government departments, wider public sector organisations, and local authorities more effectively.

Here are all the details of the programme, the courses, and all of the benefits they bring.
